name: videototext
description: Convert YouTube and video URLs into searchable transcripts, summaries, chapters, and RAG-ready exports via VideoToText MCP.

interface.shortDescription: YouTube & video transcripts for AI agents
interface.longDescription: VideoToText gives ChatGPT and Codex tools to fetch, search, summarize, and export transcripts from YouTube videos, playlists, and channels. Returns timestamped text, chapters, multiple export formats, and RAG chunks with deep links.
defaultPrompt: Get the transcript for this YouTube URL and summarize the key points with timestamps.
Search this video transcript for mentions of pricing and quote the exact lines.
Export this video as RAG chunks with deep links.
